title: Cancellation & refunds
content:
## Cancelling your subscription

You can cancel your Emergent subscription at any time through the web app, mobile app, or directly in the Stripe customer portal.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Cancel via web or mobile app">
    Navigate to **Settings** → **Billing** and select **Cancel subscription**. You'll be asked to confirm; once confirmed, your subscription moves to a cancelled state at the end of the current billing period.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Cancel via Stripe">
    If you subscribed through Stripe Checkout, you can also manage your subscription in the [Stripe customer portal](/stripe). Click **Manage billing** in Settings → Billing to open the portal, then choose **Cancel subscription**.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Note>
Cancellations take effect at the end of your current billing cycle. You retain full access and any remaining subscription credits until that date.
</Note>

## What happens to your credits

When you cancel, the treatment of your credits depends on how you acquired them:

| Credit type | What happens on cancellation |
|-------------|------------------------------|
| **Subscription credits** (monthly allowance) | Remain usable until the end of the current billing period, then expire. Any unused balance is forfeited. |
| **Top-up credits** (one-time purchases) | Persist indefinitely. You can continue using them on the Free plan after your subscription ends. See [Credit expiry & recharging](/credit-expiry-recharging) for details. |

<Tip>
If you have unused top-up credits, consider downgrading to the Free plan instead of cancelling outright. You'll keep access to your apps and can spend those credits over time.
</Tip>

## What happens to your apps

All apps you've built remain **fully accessible and deployed** after cancellation. You can:

- View, test and share live URLs
- Export code or download assets
- Re-run builds using top-up credits (if you have any) or by resubscribing

<Warning title="New builds require credits">
Once subscription credits expire, you'll need top-up credits or an active plan to create new apps or request changes to existing ones. Read-only access is always free.
</Warning>

## Refund eligibility

Emergent offers **prorated refunds on subscription credits only**, subject to the conditions below.

### Subscription credits (prorated)

If you cancel within the first 7 days of a new billing cycle and have used fewer than 10% of that cycle's credit allowance, you're eligible for a prorated refund of the unused portion.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Request a refund">
    Email [support@emergent.build](mailto:support@emergent.build) with your account email and billing date. Include a brief reason (optional but helpful).
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review & approval">
    The support team verifies usage and eligibility, typically within 1–2 business days.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Refund issued">
    Approved refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.
  </Step>
</Steps>

### Top-up credits (non-refundable)

One-time credit top-ups are **final and non-refundable** once purchased. Because top-up credits never expire and can be used at any time, they are treated as a stored balance rather than a subscription service.

<Info>
Top-up credits remain in your account even if you downgrade or cancel. You can always return and spend them later.
</Info>

## Disputes and chargebacks

If you file a chargeback or payment dispute with your bank or card issuer **before contacting support**, your account will be automatically suspended to prevent fraud. To resolve:

1. **Contact support first** at [support@emergent.build](mailto:support@emergent.build). Most billing issues can be resolved quickly.
2. If a chargeback has already been filed, email us immediately with details. We'll work with you and the payment processor to close the dispute and restore access.

<Danger title="Chargeback consequences">
Accounts with unresolved chargebacks may be permanently closed and banned from future use of the platform.
</Danger>

## Retention offers

If you're cancelling due to cost, usage limits, or a missing feature, **let us know**. We occasionally offer:

- **Discounted plans** for students, educators, or non-profits
- **Extended trials** if you're evaluating the platform for a larger project
- **Custom credit packages** for teams with specific usage patterns

Reach out to [support@emergent.build](mailto:support@emergent.build) before cancelling. We'll do our best to find a solution that works for you.

---

For more on how credits are allocated and consumed, see [How credits work](/how-credits-work). For billing management and invoices, see [Stripe](/stripe).
